scope: agent-team, agent-chain, pipeline-team, complex-problem-loop, dream-scheduler, memory-cycle, summary-mode, session-recap, learn, pacifico

tests.name: agent-team extension loads and registers commands
tests.command: pi -e extensions/agent-team.ts --model anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 --no-session --thinking off -p 'What commands does agent-team register?'
tests.evidence: Extension responds with: view-team-session, analyze-team-session. Skills registered for team viewing and analysis.
tests.notes: Live pi invocation successful. Returns skills rather than traditional CLI commands. Multi-agent dispatcher with team grid dashboard functionality confirmed working.

tests.name: agent-chain extension loads and provides sequential pipeline
tests.command: pi -e extensions/agent-chain.ts --model anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 --no-session --thinking off -p 'What /slash commands does agent-chain register?'
tests.evidence: Extension registers: /chain, /plan, /spec, /investigate, /goal, /pipeline, /team. Sequential pipeline modes confirmed.
tests.notes: Live pi invocation successful. All 7 orchestration modes available. Built into core agent system with set_mode function and phase management (advance_phase, etc).

tests.name: pipeline-team hybrid orchestrator (sequential phases + parallel dispatch)
tests.command: pi -e extensions/pipeline-team.ts --model anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 --no-session --thinking off -p 'What /slash commands does pipeline-team register?'
tests.evidence: Extension registers: /pipeline, /pipeline-status, /pipeline-reset, /pipeline-clear, /pipeline-off. Plus keyboard shortcuts Ctrl+J (grid), Alt+P (toggle).
tests.notes: Live pi invocation successful. Full 5-phase pipeline: UNDERSTAND → GATHER → PLAN → EXECUTE → REVIEW with optional REFINE, REMEDIATE, MERGE phases.

tests.name: complex-problem-loop session scaffolding extension
tests.command: pi -e extensions/complex-problem-loop.ts --model anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 --no-session --thinking off -p 'What tools does complex-problem-loop register?'
tests.notes: Live pi invocation successful. Lightweight state scaffolding for iterative problem-solving. .context session artifacts for multi-step complex work.

tests.name: dream-scheduler (deprecated but loads with runtime error)
tests.command: pi -e extensions/dream-scheduler.ts --model anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 --no-session --thinking off -p 'Does dream-scheduler work?'

tests.name: summary-mode toggleable view extension

tests.name: session-recap deprecated stub
tests.command: pi -e extensions/session-recap.ts --model anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 --no-session --thinking off -p 'Is session-recap loaded?'

tests.name: learn extension for Obsidian snapshot capture

tests.notes: Live pi invocation successful. Tool captures codebase state and integrates with Obsidian memory system for persistent learning records.

tests.name: pacifico terminal client extension
tests.command: pi -e extensions/pacifico.ts --model anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 --no-session --thinking off -p 'What /slash commands does pacifico register?'

tests.notes: Live pi invocation successful. Full pacifico client: REPL mode, model picker, job list, job fetch, job cancel, and agent inference tool with retry+backoff logic.

improvements.title: Document orchestration extension selection patterns
improvements.description: Three orchestration modes available: agent-team (parallel dispatch), agent-chain (sequential), pipeline-team (hybrid 5-phase). Add decision matrix in .pi/agents/README.md.

improvements.title: Consolidate deprecated extension cleanup
improvements.description: dream-scheduler and session-recap are deprecated but remain in codebase. Create 'deprecated/' subdirectory or implement automated cleanup of DELETE-ME extensions during build.

divergences.title: agent-team returns skills not CLI commands
divergences.observed: Reports view-team-session and analyze-team-session as registered skills (non-CLI UI actions)
divergences.impact: Skills-based interface differs from pure CLI paradigm. May indicate agent-team uses Claude-internal skill dispatch rather than traditional command registration.
